facts.claim: La Pedrera is Casa Milà by Gaudí, with a nature-related architectural approach and different visitor experiences.
facts.excerpt: Pedrera More than a building, La Pedrera - Casa Milà is emotion made stone. Gaudí broke the rules to give shape to a living work, where light, curves and details dialogue with nature. Walking through it is entering the heart of Catalan Modernisme and touching the genius of one of the most visionary creators in history. Discover it. Feel its soul. Let yourself be surprised. La Pedrera, a UNESCO World Heritage Site Since 1984, Casa Milà has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site given its incalculable artistic value and architectural uniqueness. Read more
